items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: Harry K. Thor, what's his name? Harry K. Thor.

ctx.x: For me. Well, I got friends coming from Chicago, going to Paris, blah, blah, blah. So I'm the only guy in New York in them days who could work seven days. So we're working at Leslie House. It's called the Blair House now on West 56th Street. Unless they change the name again. Harry K. Thor, what's his name? Harry K. Thor.
